title: Oligarch is a browser game vibecoded with Claude
author: SeparateSpend1542
selftext:
I built Oligarch as a project to learn about vibe coding and see if I could do it. 

I had no prior coding experience but had always wanted to make a video game since I first played Oregon Trail as a kid (which inspired the art style).

Normally, the arcade games in Olly’s Arcade are unlocked one by one as you encounter them in story mode, but I unlocked them for this post so it’s easier to play more casually.

Let me know in the comments what you think and if you have ideas for how to make it better.

https://oligarchthegame.com
